venues.note: Tour Gary's shop and studio to see what's brewing for Halloween this year.
Featuring affordable giclée prints from a variety of our favorite artists. Take an insider's tour of our screen printing shop and darkroom while enjoying Dr. Banzai's spinning vinyl.
Visit the ETC gallery to see the annual Eugene Weavers' Guild Open Show! Featuring handwoven art from local guild members.
Sourdough bagels, FRIPP jewelry, and video art.

We're doing something new! Featuring the original artwork of Shannon Carleen Knight, a self-taught Eugene artist whose vibrant, richly layered acrylic paintings combine bold color and collage. Grab some coffee, play in the arcade, color, and watch cartoons. Lola's Mahal will be here from 11am to 4pm with Filipino and soul food fusions.

The Parking Meter Art show opens in the Main Gallery, featuring 180 artworks that 40 artists created for the Eugene Parking Meter Art Project. All pieces priced at $30! Guest artist Richard Quigley shows his surrealist paintings and 3D creations, with a talk at 2pm.

Live music at 6pm from Wellington Drive. Drawing on Crosby, Stills & Nash, The Beatles, and Simon & Garfunkel for inspiration, Wellington Drive delivers 3-part harmonies, sparkling keyboards and guitars, and exciting arrangements of original songs and loved classics.
Three makers celebrating art, creation, and woodworking: photography, digital art, costumes, jewelry, games, furniture, and larger construction projects. Come see our wares and costumes!

Featuring three artists: Josh Thornley's mixed media and wooden art from up-cycled materials, fine handmade leather goods from John of Alejandro Leather, and Eep's illuminated objects made with metal, fire, and electricity. Wine and chocolate provided!
